title: Relay connector reference
scope: Connector capabilities, verification and current limitations.

connectors.name: HTTP / HTTPS
connectors.implemented: Partner PUT/POST/GET, JSON directory listings, Basic/Bearer auth, verified TLS, authenticated durable inbox and NAS routing.
connectors.verification: Local HTTP roundtrip and NAS-routing tests
connectors.gaps: Server-specific CONNECT/CONFIRM choreography, multipart forms, automatic retries and full action language.

connectors.name: FTP / FTPS
connectors.implemented: Binary STOR/RETR, MLSD listing, passive/active mode, verified explicit/implicit TLS client and explicit TLS NAS listener.
connectors.verification: Real FTP and explicit FTPS socket roundtrips
connectors.gaps: ASCII translation, LIST fallback, resume, proxy/dial-up, raw QUOTE/SITE commands. Remote FTP overwrite protection is preflight only.

connectors.name: File
connectors.implemented: Rooted native/NAS reads and writes, browse, exclusive file creation, optional parent directories and token-based post-processing.
connectors.verification: Actual local NAS files and post-processing tests
connectors.gaps: Unrestricted absolute paths, arbitrary JavaScript/date expressions, custom macro expansion and command-output log capture.

connectors.name: Event stream
connectors.implemented: Topic publish/consume, record keys/partitions, SASL/TLS and client certificates, durable inbox before explicit offset commit.
connectors.verification: Real stream broker NAS-to-broker-to-NAS demo and replay/failure tests
connectors.gaps: Runtime-specific tuning, Java keystores, multi-topic publishing, automatic offset commit. Idempotent producer does not make the complete NAS pipeline exactly-once.

connectors.name: LDAP
connectors.implemented: Sync bind, filtered user search, escaped username filters, user bind authentication, LDAPS/StartTLS, DNS SRV and manual failover.
connectors.verification: Adapter/API contract and filter-injection tests; live directory required
connectors.gaps: Comma-separated filter shorthand and URI overrides, SAML provisioning, automatic workspace login and full Users-host policy model.

connectors.name: SFTP
connectors.implemented: SSH browse/upload/download, password/private-key login, trusted host fingerprint, compression and optional parent directories.
connectors.verification: Adapter tests; live partner SSH endpoint required
connectors.gaps: OpenPGP packaging, per-algorithm negotiation UI, transfer resume, proxy rotation, virtual Users-host folders and custom URI schemes.

connectors.name: Document library
connectors.implemented: Application-client OAuth, library discovery, rooted listings, conflict-rejecting chunked uploads and ETag-conditioned downloads.
connectors.verification: Document-library adapter contract and URL/auth/conflict tests; live tenant required
connectors.gaps: Cross-site/cross-drive URI browsing, rename/move/delete, folder creation and sovereign-cloud endpoints.

connectors.name: SMB
connectors.implemented: Rooted network-share browse/read/write, domain credentials, SMB3 encryption, exclusive creation and optional parent folders.
connectors.verification: Adapter tests; live NAS/share credentials required
connectors.gaps: SMB1 legacy/FIPS mode, selectable dialect bounds, client-specific tuning and cache controls.

connectors.name: AS2
connectors.implemented: Signed, encrypted and compressed documents; verified synchronous/asynchronous receipts; durable inbound acceptance and replay protection.
connectors.verification: Real local HTTP exchange in both directions with verified signed receipts
connectors.gaps: Reachability checks require a document exchange for full partner verification; no automatic document resend after uncertain delivery.

connectors.name: Object storage
connectors.implemented: Rooted bucket listings, generation-checked downloads and exclusive new-object uploads with service account or default credentials.
connectors.verification: Adapter contracts; live bucket access required
connectors.gaps: No object deletion, rename or resumable uploads.

connectors.name: JMS messaging
connectors.implemented: Persistent transacted bytes/text publication to a queue or topic through an installed broker client and Java 17 bridge.
connectors.verification: Bridge contract and source compilation; installed broker client required
connectors.gaps: Outbound only; no subscriptions, OAuth or broker failover URL lists.
